# x402-router

> Standalone x402 v2 facilitator router for any Fetch API runtime. One facilitator URL, https://x402-router.equator-owl-studio.workers.dev, routes each payment to PrimeV, CDP, or x402.org by network.

## Docs

- /index.md - The router in five lines: URL, endpoints, rails, license.
- /docs/index.md - What the hosted router is and the four endpoints it exposes.
- /docs/getting-started.md - Use the hosted facilitator URL or deploy your own.
- /docs/integration.md - Normal x402 integration with a router-backed facilitator URL.
- /docs/upstreams.md - How the default router chooses facilitators per rail.
- /docs/self-hosting.md - Deploy the router on any Fetch API runtime.
- /docs/license.md - Apache-2.0 terms for the router and hosted app.

## API

- GET /supported - The payment kinds and extensions the router accepts.
- POST /verify - Verify a payment payload against a payment requirement.
- POST /settle - Settle a verified payment on its upstream facilitator.
- GET /health - Liveness check with the deployed commit.
